name: dev-team
displayName: 软件开发团队 Dev Team
description: 角色化软件开发团队：主代理作为技术负责人接收并拆解需求，按任务依赖与文件所有权串行/并行派发 PM、架构师、前后端工程师、QA、浏览器验收员、代码评审员等子智能体，全流程交付并贴真实测试输出；可选以 GenUI 视图呈现任务 DAG 与质量门缺陷看板。A role-based software development team: the lead agent decomposes a requirement and dispatches PM / architect / backend & frontend devs / QA / browser tester / reviewer subagents in dependency-aware serial-parallel stages, with optional GenUI views of the task DAG and the QA/review defect triage.
author: Lin
